name: zovo-docstring-generator
displayName: Docstring Generator & Python Docstring Updater (Google, NumPy, Sphinx, JSDoc)
description: Free docstring generator for Python: type """ under a def or class and press Enter. Google, NumPy, Sphinx (reST) and Epytext styles or your own template, filled from the signature: type hints, defaults, *args, **kwargs, positional-only and keyword-only parameters, return type, yield, raise, dataclass fields and __init__ arguments. Updates a python docstring when the signature changes and keeps your text. JSDoc with TypeScript types for JS and TS. No sign-in, works offline.

untrustedWorkspaces.description: In Restricted Mode the custom template path from the workspace settings is not used.

enumDescriptions: Google style: Args:, Returns:, Yields:, Raises:
NumPy style: Parameters / Returns sections with dashed underlines
zovoDoc.style.description: Docstring style for new Python docstrings. Updating keeps the style a docstring already has.

zovoDoc.customTemplatePath.markdownDescription: Mustache template for the `custom` style. Relative paths start at the workspace folder; `~`, `${workspaceFolder}`, `${userHome}` and `${env:NAME}` work. See the README for the variables.

enumDescriptions: Write the type hint, or a type placeholder when there is no hint
Write types only when the signature has a type hint
No types in docstrings (the type hints are enough, PEP 484)

zovoDoc.optionalMarker.description: Add ", optional" after the type of a parameter that has a default (Google and Sphinx).

zovoDoc.quoteStyle.description: Quotes for docstrings made by commands. Typing ''' uses ''' anyway.

zovoDoc.summaryOnNewLine.description: Start the summary on the line after the opening quotes (pydocstyle D213) instead of on the same line (D212).

zovoDoc.includeExtendedSummary.description: Add an extended description placeholder under the summary.

zovoDoc.blankLineAfterLastSection.description: Put a blank line before the closing quotes (pydocstyle D413).

zovoDoc.generateOnTripleQuote.description: Offer "Generate Docstring" in the suggestions when you type """ or ''' under a def or class.

zovoDoc.generateOnEnter.description: Also generate when you press Enter after """ and the suggestion was not shown or not picked.

enumDescriptions: List the __init__ arguments in the class docstring
zovoDoc.classInitArguments.description: Where the __init__ arguments of a class are documented.

enumDescriptions: Keep the text of a removed parameter and mark it [removed from the signature]
zovoDoc.update.removedParameters.description: What Update Docstring does with a parameter that is no longer in the signature. Parameters that only hold a placeholder are always deleted.

zovoDoc.updateOnSave.description: Update the docstrings of a Python file when you save it (new, renamed and removed parameters, types, Returns and Raises).

zovoDoc.bulk.skipPrivate.description: Add Missing Docstrings and the coverage report skip names that start with _ (except __init__).

zovoDoc.jsdoc.typesInTypeScript.description: Write {types} in JSDoc in TypeScript files too.

zovoDoc.report.maxFileMB.description: The coverage report skips Python files larger than this.

zovoDoc.showSupportLinks.description: Show the small Rate, More free tools, Sponsor and PayPal links at the bottom of the coverage report.

zovoDoc.askForRating.description: Ask for a Marketplace rating at most twice, after the extension worked for you in two sessions.

walkthroughs.title: Get started with Docstring Generator
walkthroughs.description: Docstrings from the signature in Google, NumPy, Sphinx or Epytext style, and JSDoc for JS and TS.

steps.title: Type """ and press Enter
steps.description: On the line under a def or class, type three quotes and press Enter. Tab moves through the placeholders.

steps.title: Pick a style
steps.description:
Google is the default. NumPy, Sphinx (reST), Epytext or your own template are one setting away.
[Choose Docstring Style](command:zovoDoc.chooseStyle)

steps.title: Update after the signature changed
steps.description:
Renamed, added or removed a parameter? Put the cursor in the function and run Update Docstring. Your text stays.
[Update Docstring](command:zovoDoc.update)

steps.title: JSDoc with types
steps.description:
In JavaScript and TypeScript, type /** above a function and pick "JSDoc with types", or run Generate JSDoc.
[Generate JSDoc](command:zovoDoc.generateJsdoc)
